Common mistakes on Dynamic Island listings for China

  • Leaving "Dynamic Island" as the only caption — branded term without a zh-Hans benefit line ("在灵动岛实时查看进度") looks unfinished
  • Literal "Check it on the Island" → 在岛上查看 — vague; name what the buyer sees in compact or expanded view
  • Machine-translated "Live on Dynamic Island" as 在动态岛直播 — sounds like livestreaming; align with Apple's 灵动岛 framing and your actual UX
  • Conflating Dynamic Island with Live Activities — island is the UI surface; Live Activities is one feature that uses it — different buyer stories when your page only shows island branding
  • Conflating Dynamic Island with widgets — Home Screen widgets live in the widget gallery; island is the top-of-screen pill on supported iPhones
  • Caption lines that describe island UI your build does not ship — metadata must match actual compact/expanded behavior and device requirements
  • Assuming island engineering localizes the store page — UI implementation and App Store metadata are independent workstreams
  • English-only What's New after a Dynamic Island launch — version notes are a separate field; base $79 focuses on evergreen listing fields unless you bundle What's New in intake

What good zh-Hans Dynamic Island listing copy looks like

Align tone with your en-US listing and name the island surfaces buyers actually see:

  • Name & subtitle (30 chars each) — lead with the outcome (灵动岛实时状态, 长按展开更多控制) not SDK jargon alone
  • Keywords (100 chars) — Simplified Chinese queries for 灵动岛, compact view, live status where relevant — not English API names stuffed into the hidden field
  • Description — one clear paragraph on what appears in compact view, what expands on long-press, and which iPhone models support island UI
  • Screenshot captions — one line per frame naming the on-screen island state: "紧凑视图显示实时进度" not "Compact Dynamic Island view" alone
  • Honest scope — if island features require iPhone 14 Pro or later, login, or subscription, say so in plain zh-Hans

Dynamic Island screenshot captions Chinese buyers expect

Many indie apps dedicate one or two gallery frames to the Dynamic Island story — compact status pill, expanded controls, or island marketing overlays. Caption lines on those frames should name the feature in plain zh-Hans:

  • Compact view frame — describe what fits in the pill: "灵动岛紧凑视图实时显示订单状态" instead of "Compact Dynamic Island view" alone
  • Expanded view frame — name what long-press reveals: "长按灵动岛展开完整控制面板" vs vague "Check it on the Island"
  • Live status frame — state what updates in real time: "配送进度在灵动岛持续更新" — not English-only "Live on Dynamic Island"
  • Control / action frame — explain what the buyer can do from the island: "无需打开 App，在灵动岛一键暂停计时" when art shows controls
  • Match caption to capture — if the screenshot shows compact view only, the overlay should describe 紧凑视图 not 展开视图 unless art shows expansion
